notes.title: PATCH NOTE V 1.11
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26885387/7d6e846f815478cdc58614eb7941ae58b5eac706.jpg[/img]

Greetings contenders, We bring you good news with a patch Which main objective is to fix the long queue times. Finally We totally recommend the 2vs2 mode.

[h1] PATCH NOTE V 1.11[/h1]
[list]
 
 [*]Introducing a system that helps to reduce the queue time on the matchmaking.
 [*]Improved AI behaviour to make it more balanced and realistic.
 [*]Solved multiple bugs that had Ryunosuke. -> solves multiple bugs with Ryunosuke
 [*]Solved error with Darcey lifesteal on online games.
 [*]Introduces some changes making the Match Observer more stable and useful.
 [*]Minor graphical corrections.
[/list]
